title: Fireflies.ai Review (2026)
intro: Fireflies.ai is evaluated here as AI software — Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting notetaker (bot or Chrome extension) for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Transcription is unlimited on every plan; storage, video recording, conversation intelligence, and admin/compliance are the gates. Free is $0 with 400 minutes team storage. Pro is $10/seat/mo billed annually ($18 monthly) with 8,000 minutes/seat storage and video recording. Business (most popular) is $19/seat/mo annual ($29 monthly) with unlimited storage and conversation intelligence. Enterprise is $39/seat/mo annual-only (SSO, SCIM, HIPAA). Distinct from Otter.ai (meeting-notes peer) and from Microsoft 365 Copilot Teams recap (workspace LLM add-on). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Fireflies.ai when AI meeting notes and conversation intelligence are the job — not a general LLM or Teams-recap add-on alone.
verdict: Choose Fireflies.ai when AI meeting notes and conversation intelligence are the job — not a general LLM or Teams-recap add-on alone. Compare Otter.ai for a lower individual Pro floor; Microsoft 365 Copilot if Teams recap is already in the tenant. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.

AskFred, AI Skills, soundbites, and Business conversation intelligence add a post-meeting loop.
Unlimited integrations on paid plans (Zoom/Meet/Teams, Slack, CRM, API).
SOC2/GDPR on the platform; HIPAA, SSO/SCIM, and private storage are Enterprise.
Free → Pro → Business → Enterprise is a clear seat ladder.
Annual Pro $10 is a strong individual floor; Business is the team SKU. Affiliate economics excluded.
Meeting-specialist models and AskFred — not frontier general LLM compute.
